readiness_note: These are minimal data-diversity checks, not sufficient statistical support or accuracy thresholds. Publish actual support, including scarce/missing camera cells. A failed check stops preparation before sensor archive work.
near_gt: Positive camera-axis Z in (0,6], unchanged object ownership, nearest-return raster, semantic/timing/edge guards and original RGB coordinates from the reviewed coverage/benchmark helpers. No interpolation.
broad_gt: Conservative raw-metre 2-80m returns from the same positive-Z projection, nearest-pixel z-buffer before semantic/range filtering, original 5px/0.5m guard. Stored separately from object-owned near masks; no semantic noise/ego labels.
io_policy: Local-first. Stage reviewed coverage chunks into one reusable source-state ZIP once, or upload the coverage folder ZIP from the Drive website. No automatic retries/remounts. Sensor archives are copied sequentially one at a time; publish one verified train-only ZIP per source part. Acknowledged local progress avoids repeat Drive input reads on the same VM.
